purpose: Radar of HIGH/MEDIUM findings still actionable. Epistemic statuses preserved; nothing here certifies scientific truth. The Chief CTO must route any new claim to a lane/team for validation before use.

findings.summary: First repo-hygiene execution permanently deleted the raw Actions logs of 102 runs. For 4 of the 5 deleted Critical CTO Council runs no run-id-attributable durable artifact exists anywhere in Git; whether those reviews contained unique advisory prescriptions is unknowable post-deletion (loss_assessment=UNKNOWN). The other 98 deletions are assessed NONE_MATERIAL (orchestration-only, or fully recovered).
actionable_next: Decide whether any pre-CTO-4 council pass needs reconstruction from any surviving side channel (none currently known); if not, close the UNKNOWNs as accepted residual risk.
Do not treat reconstructed summaries of the four UNKNOWN council runs as evidence; none exists.

findings.summary: Recoverability gap is structural, not accidental: exactly one deleted run (council run 32876814203) had persisted its output before pruning (origin/lab/cto@6b1f030); all other deleted runs left nothing attributable. Council/supervisor/workdog workflows emit no durable receipt tying their run id to their effects.
actionable_next: Require every autonomous workflow (cto-council, *-supervisor, watchdogs, hygiene) to commit a run-id-attributed receipt before completion, so future pruning cannot orphan outputs.
Gate future hygiene passes on evidence/run-memory safe_to_prune flags instead of recency heuristics only.

findings.summary: The hygiene script version that executed the 102 deletions (commit 3e5ea6d) had no distillation requirement; maintainers hardened it after the fact (1afb229 'require durable run distillation before pruning', a09d036 'restore durable-reference protection'). Until the hardened version has executed successfully, assume un-distilled claim-bearing logs could still be pruned by a stale workflow version.
actionable_next: Verify the next hygiene dispatch runs the hardened script and that run 32880942022 itself stays protected (its log is the sole deletion manifest; safe_to_prune=false).

findings.summary: Orchestration noise dominates Actions economics: 102 supervisor/watchdog/council runs were created in ~18.2h (~5.6/h; Ox Watchdog alone = 39) versus 54 retained substantive runs. Each hygiene pass costs ~43s of sequential DELETE API calls per 100 deletions.
actionable_next: Evaluate consolidating watchdog/supervisor cadence or event-triggering them instead of fixed heartbeats; measure runner minutes saved against recovery-latency risk before changing anything.
